info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Account Amount Management API
info.description: The Account Amount Management API allows for the submission of financial amounts associated with specific customer accounts. This endpoint is essential for applications needing to update or record monetary transactions tied to a customer's account, such as deposits, withdrawals, or adjustments. Typical consumers include financial institutions, mobile banking applications, and accounting services. By facilitating precise management of account amounts, the API enhances the visibility and accuracy of customer financial records.

post.summary: Create amounts for a specific account of a customer.
post.description: This operation allows for the creation of new amounts for a specific account belonging to a customer identified by their unique ID. Ensure all required data for the amount is included in the request.
